findings.observation: Sheet 5, Block 11 contains a 'FIRE DEPARTMENT' section with 7 numbered notes. Comparing to the reference Fire Department notes from the General Site Plan Notes for COA: Note 2 on the plan says 'HYDRANTS MUST BE INSTALLED WITH THE CENTER OF THE FOUR-INCH OPENING AT LEAST 18 INCHES ABOVE FINISHED GRADE; THE FOUR-INCH OPENING MUST FACE THE DRIVEWAY OR STREET WITH VISIBILTY TO THE STREET; A SEVEN FOOT CLEARANCE NO OBSTRUCTION IS ALLOWED WITHIN THREE FEET OF ANY HYDRANT' while the reference says 'with three- to six-foot setbacks from the curbline(s).' Note 5 on the plan says 'COMBUSTIBLE CONSTRUCTION NON-CONFORMANCE: NO COMBUSTIBLE CONSTRUCTION NON-CONFORMANCE SHALL BE STORED OR PLACED WITHIN TEN FEET' while the reference says 'Commercial dumpsters and containers with an individual capacity of 1.5 cubic yards or greater shall not be stored or placed within ten feet of openings, combustible walls, or combustible eave lines.'
findings.reasoning: The validation methodology for AF-01 requires '~90% semantic threshold' and states to 'flag as deficient only when required notes are missing, substantively altered, or semantically different from the reference.' Note 2 is substantively altered: it removes the curbline setback requirement (3-6 feet from curb) and replaces it with a '7 foot clearance' requirement that lacks the curbline reference. Note 5 is semantically different: the reference addresses dumpster placement near openings/walls/eaves, while the plan addresses storage of 'combustible construction non-conformance' materials - these are different fire safety concerns. Note 5 on the plan appears to be a completely different requirement that does not satisfy the dumpster placement requirement in the reference.
findings.explanation: Fire Department notes 2 and 5 substantively differ from reference: note 2 omits curbline setback; note 5 addresses combustible materials instead of dumpster placement
findings.resolution: Revise Fire Department notes 2 and 5 to match the standard text. Note 2 must include 'The four-inch opening must face the driveway or street with three- to six-foot setbacks from the curbline(s).' Note 5 must address commercial dumpster placement: 'Commercial dumpsters and containers with an individual capacity of 1.5 cubic yards or greater shall not be stored or placed within ten feet of openings, combustible walls, or combustible eave lines.' See the CoA standard notes template for the expected notes.
